items.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
items.title_zh: AgentOdyssey：面向测试时持续学习智能体的开放式长程文本游戏生成
items.summary: AgentOdyssey procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics and long-horizon tasks to evaluate test-time continual learning agents, interleaving learning and inference throughout deployment. Across six generated games, even the top agent remained far below human performance, and supervised fine-tuning agents still suffered catastrophic forgetting despite short-term memory benefits.

items.title: KG-Guard: Graph-Based Hallucination Detection for Knowledge Base Question Answering
items.title_zh: KG-Guard：面向知识库问答的基于图的幻觉检测
items.summary: KG-Guard formulates hallucination detection in knowledge base question answering as answer-node classification and treats the answering LLM as a black box, representing each instance as an augmented graph with a virtual question node. It reports F1 of 82.0, 87.4 and 84.3 on WebQSP, ComplexWebQuestions and PUGG with roughly 305x fewer parameters than LLM-based baselines, and feeding flagged answers back improves downstream KBQA F1 by 13.0-14.5 points.

items.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
items.title_zh: 屏蔽过期观测对搜索智能体有帮助——直到不再有帮助：机制与状态图
items.summary: The authors sweep agent backbones from 4B to 284B parameters and three retrievers on offline and live-web agentic search benchmarks to study masking stale observations from context. They find accuracy gains follow an asymmetric inverted-U shape relative to the model's unmasked accuracy, reflecting the interaction between retriever recall and the model's implicit filtering capacity.

items.title: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG
items.title_zh: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG：像素原生搜索，终结网页解析
items.summary: StarTrail-org's PixelRAG is an open-source Python project pitched as the end of web parsing and the beginning of scalable pixel-native search, tied to an arXiv paper and pixelrag.ai. It had 10,352 stars, 918 forks and topics including RAG, memory and multimodal.

items.title: Towards Verifiable Multimodal Deep Research: A Multi-Agent Harness for Interleaved Report Generation
items.title_zh: 迈向可验证的多模态深度研究：面向图文交错报告生成的多智能体框架
items.summary: A Renmin University multi-agent harness plans, researches and writes interleaved multimodal reports, keeping source-aligned images in a visual working memory and using a verifier agent to enforce grounding and cross-modal consistency. It also introduces the PtahEval evaluation protocol.

items.title: CRMA: A Spectrally-Bounded Backbone for Modular Continual Fine-Tuning of LLMs
items.title_zh: CRMA：面向 LLM 模块化持续微调的光谱有界骨干
items.summary: CRMA is a residual adapter whose internal mixing matrix is doubly stochastic at every forward pass via Sinkhorn normalization, giving a structural spectral bound rather than a penalty. On Mistral-7B across five sequential domains, modular per-task LoRA on a CRMA backbone reportedly reduces loss-relative drift from +42.96% to -0.17% and improves prior-task holdout loss over a frozen-substrate baseline.

items.title: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
items.title_zh: 确定性视界：何时扩展推理失效、工具委派成为必要
items.summary: The paper presents an attention bottleneck analysis arguing that total state-tracking capacity in bits is bounded by head count, head dimension and context length, and defines a Deterministic Horizon of 19-31 marking the depth where unaided accuracy crosses 50%. Across twelve models and eight task domains, tool-integrated reasoning reaches 76-94% accuracy versus 17-42% for neural chain-of-thought on PermutationProbe.

items.title: Bridging Reasoning Trajectories in On-Policy Distillation via Near-Future Guidance
items.title_zh: 通过近未来引导弥合同策略蒸馏中的推理轨迹
items.summary: The paper shows that on-policy distillation's token-level learning signal cannot reliably bridge student trajectories toward teacher trajectories, since about 30% of high-loss tokens are surface-form mismatches rather than real reasoning forks. Its Trajectory-aware OPD uses near-future trajectory information to identify divergent states and distribute guidance, improving average accuracy to 52.2% from 47.8% for standard OPD.

items.title: Skill0.5: Joint Skill Internalization and Utilization for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Skill0.5：智能体强化学习中的技能内化与调用联合优化
items.summary: An East China Normal University framework internalizes general skills through privileged distillation while keeping task-specific skills external, routed by a difficulty-aware router that penalizes shortcuts on easy tasks. It is reported to outperform memory- and skill-based RL baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop.

items.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
items.title_zh: AgentDoG 1.5：面向 AI 智能体安全与防护的轻量可扩展对齐框架
items.summary: AgentDoG 1.5 is a Shanghai AI Lab alignment framework for AI agents, trained on roughly 1,000 taxonomy-guided samples to produce guardrail models from 0.8B to 8B parameters. The authors report performance comparable to closed-source models such as GPT-5.4 and release all models and datasets.

items.title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM
items.title_zh: CONF-KV：面向长程 LLM 的置信度感知 KV 缓存淘汰与混合精度存储
items.summary: CONF-KV is a KV-cache manager from Carnegie Mellon that sets the per-step cache budget from the model's next-token confidence, combined with blockwise online-softmax attention and mixed FP16/INT8 storage. It reaches 91.4% Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval at 32K tokens, versus 53.8% for sliding windows.

items.title: zhnt/loushang
items.title_zh: zhnt/loushang：Python 编写的 AI 原生编程智能体框架
items.summary: loushang is a Python agent harness for coding workflows with multi-model LLM orchestration, stateful sessions, tool governance and provider routing for GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and MiniMax. The repository had 1,870 stars and 294 forks.

items.title: A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations
items.title_zh: 可信第三方评估的共同行动手册
items.summary: OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards and validity for frontier systems.

items.title: Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you
items.title_zh: Claude Code：文档里没写的所有可配置项
items.summary: A developer's reading of the Claude Code source code documents undocumented configuration, including hook fields that rewrite commands mid-flight, persistent agent memory, plain-English auto-mode rules and self-improving loops, with copy-paste examples. The post drew 326 points on Hacker News.

items.title: Notes from the Mistral AI Now Summit
items.title_zh: Mistral AI Now 峰会笔记
items.summary: Conference notes from a few days in Paris at the Mistral AI Now Summit cover open models, on-premise deployment and agentic harnesses, along with Mistral's ambition to be Europe's full-stack AI partner. The post drew 466 points and 214 comments on Hacker News.
